sources.title: 2026 All-Juice Team: One play from Fernando Mendoza earned him instant entry to this squad
sources.description: On a team and in a process that has always sought QBs who could lead and elevate players around them, Mendoza's inclusion became a no-brainer. With that in mind, we give you the 12th installment of the All-Juice Team.
